name: Yellow flag iris
note: Yellow flag iris (docs 10, 14). habitat, growth, flowering, dormant, spread and starter work as in reeds.json: iris wants the wet bank just above the water, a little drier than reeds, and tolerates only a few centimeters of standing water. Shape (flora-iris.wgsl): a clump is fansPerClump fans (more as it grows) at r = clumpRadius x u from the center; each fan is leavesPerFan flat sword leaves in one plane at a hashed bearing, spread over fanDeg either side of upright and arching outward by arch (share of the height), the middle leaves tallest. Leaf height = maxHeight x size, varied by heightVar, never under sproutM; leaves are leafWidth wide, tapering to a point. A seed shows as seedLeaves short leaves; a dormant clump keeps leaves of dormantHeight of their height, browned. A flowering clump carries flowersPerClump flowers (more as it grows) on stalks stalkShare of the leaf height, each three drooping falls and three small upright standards of flowerSize. season: albedo of the leaves (linear) per season; autumnTips is how far down from the tip the autumn brown tipBrown reaches. wind: sway is the tip bend per unit wind (share of height), stiffness keeps the base straight, gustM and gustSpeed size the passing gusts. look: sinkM below the bed, rootShade at the base, wetDarken in rain, pixelWidth keeps far leaves at least that wide.
